lessons.title: Ne zamandır?
lessons.goal: for ve since ile hâlâ devam eden durumların ne zamandır sürdüğünü anlatabilirim.

questions.prompt: Since when has Murat lived in Izmir?

learn.explanation:
Geçmişte başlayıp **şu anda da devam eden** durumlar için **present perfect** kullanılır.

- I**'ve lived** in Izmir **since** 2019. (Hâlâ orada yaşıyorum.)
- She**'s been** married **for** two years. (Hâlâ evli.)

| for + **süre** | since + **başlangıç noktası** |
|---|---|
| for three years | since 2019 |
| for six months | since January |
| for a long time / ages | since last summer |
| for two hours | since 9 o'clock |
| for a week | since I was a child |

**Soru:** **How long have** you **lived** here? – **For** five years. / **Since** 2020.

**Durum fiilleri** (know, be, have, like) bu yapıda simple halde kalır:

- I**'ve known** her **for** ten years. (~~I know her for ten years.~~)

examples.en: I've known Selin since primary school.
How long have you had your car?
We haven't seen each other for ages.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "2019'dan beri İzmir'de yaşıyorum" deriz ve şimdiki zaman kullanırız; bu yüzden Türkçe konuşanlar "I live here since 2019" ya da "I am living here for three years" der. İngilizcede geçmişten bugüne süren bir durum için present perfect zorunludur: I've lived here since 2019.

I've known him for ten years.

discover.title: Bir yazarın biyografisi
discover.body:
Leyla Kara is a novelist and teacher.

She was born in Kayseri and lived there for eighteen years. Then she moved to Istanbul to study literature. She worked as a journalist for ten years, from 2005 to 2015.

In 2015 she published her first novel. Since then, she has written four more books, and she has won two national prizes.

She has lived in Bodrum for the last six years, and she has taught creative writing at a local school since 2020.

learn.explanation:
**for** hem past simple hem present perfect ile kullanılabilir, ama anlam farklıdır:

| Past simple + for | Present perfect + for |
|---|---|
| Süre **bitti**. | Süre **hâlâ devam ediyor**. |
| She **lived** in Kayseri **for** 18 years. (Artık orada yaşamıyor.) | She**'s lived** in Bodrum **for** six years. (Hâlâ orada.) |
| I **worked** there **for** ten years. | I**'ve worked** here **for** ten years. |

**since** neredeyse her zaman **present perfect** ile kullanılır (bugüne kadar).

**Sorularda:**

- **How long did** you **live** in Paris? (Artık Paris'te değil.)
- **How long have** you **lived** in Paris? (Hâlâ Paris'te.)

**since + past simple cümle:**

- I**'ve lived** here **since** I **got** married.

learn.explanation:
**Present perfect continuous** geçmişte başlayıp **hâlâ devam eden** (ya da az önce biten) **etkinlikleri** anlatır. **Süreç ve süre** vurgulanır.

**Yapı:** have / has + **been** + fiil-**ing**

| | |
|---|---|
| I / You / We / They **have been** | working |
| He / She / It **has been** | working |

- I**'ve been learning** English **for** three years.
- She**'s been working** here **since** May.
- **How long have** you **been waiting**? – **For** twenty minutes.

**Az önce biten etkinlik + görünen sonuç:**

- You look tired. – Yes, I**'ve been running**. (Koştum, o yüzden yorgunum.)
- It**'s been raining**. The streets are wet.

**Olumsuz:** I **haven't been sleeping** well lately.

learn.explanation:
| Present perfect **simple** | Present perfect **continuous** |
|---|---|
| **Sonuç, tamamlanan iş** | **Süreç, etkinliğin kendisi** |
| **Kaç tane / ne kadar?** (how many / how much) | **Ne zamandır?** (how long) |
| I**'ve written** three emails. | I**'ve been writing** emails all morning. |
| She**'s read** 200 pages. | She**'s been reading** for two hours. |
| I**'ve painted** the kitchen. (bitti) | I**'ve been painting** the kitchen. (bitmeyebilir; üstüm boyalı) |

**Sayı ya da miktar varsa → simple:**

- I**'ve drunk** four coffees today. (~~I've been drinking four coffees~~)

**Durum fiilleri → her zaman simple:**

- I**'ve known** her for years. (~~I've been knowing~~)
- He**'s had** that car since 2010.

**Bazı fiillerde ikisi de doğru, anlam neredeyse aynı:** live, work, study, teach

- I've lived / I've been living here for five years.

examples.en: I've been cleaning all day, and I've cleaned three rooms.

discover.title: Eski bir arkadaşa e-posta
discover.body:
Hi Jess,

It's been ages since we last spoke! I'm sorry I haven't written for so long. A lot has changed since we finished university.

First, big news: I've moved to Barcelona! I've been living here for about eight months. I've been learning Spanish, and I've just passed my first exam.

I've also changed career. I was an accountant for five years, but I never really enjoyed it. Since September I've been working as a tour guide, and I love it.

The only bad thing is that I've been missing my family a lot lately. What about you? What have you been doing? Have you finished your master's yet?

Love,
Defne

questions.prompt: How long has Defne been living in Barcelona?
questions.explanation: "I've been living here for about eight months."

questions.prompt: What was Defne's old job?
questions.explanation: "I was an accountant for five years"

learn.explanation:
**Uzun aradan sonra yazmak / konuşmak:**

- **It's been ages** since we last spoke. / Long time no see!
- I'm sorry I **haven't written for** so long.
- **A lot has changed since** ...

**Haberleri vermek:**

- **Big news:** I've moved / I've got engaged / I've changed jobs!
- I**'ve just** + V3 → I've just passed my exam.
- I**'ve been** + -ing **for** ... → I've been living here for eight months.

**Değişimi anlatmak:**

| Kalıp | Örnek |
|---|---|
| I used to ..., but now ... | I used to be shy, but now I'm more confident. (9. ünitede ayrıntılı) |
| I was ... for ..., but since ... I've been ... | I was an accountant for five years, but since September I've been working as a guide. |
| I've become + sıfat | I've become more patient. |
| ... has changed a lot | My life has changed a lot. |

**Karşı tarafa sormak:** What have you been doing? / What have you been up to? / Have you ... yet?

questions.modelAnswer: My life has changed a lot in the last five years. Five years ago I was a student in Eskişehir. I lived in a small flat with three friends for four years, and I worked part-time in a café. Then, in 2021, I got my first job in Istanbul. I've worked as a software developer since then, and I've been promoted once. I've also met the love of my life. We've been together for three years, and we've been living together since last summer. Recently I've been learning to cook, and I've become much more organised. I've also been trying to exercise more lately. I think I've grown up a lot!
